scenes.hold: the title and the two-line opening over the instrumental, one continuous move round the first flame
one walk up the road from Adam's stone to Seth's: the verse is one journey
the flame travels the whole shelf, lamp to lamp, in one take
one crane up from the inscribed ledge over the homes of the valley
one descent over the spiral of lamps as it lights
scenes.rest: the camera keeps walking or gliding at the cuts; only its mid-shot turn or transit is faster, so the ends measure low against that peak
